<section id="agent" class="band t-slate" aria-labelledby="agent-h">
<div class="wrap">
<div class="eyebrow"><span><b>30%</b>The agent</span></div>
<p class="crit"><small>Official criterion</small><q>How well the agent, or the system of agents, handles a substantial task from start to finish.</q></p>
<h2 id="agent-h">Each of the 8 Focus Areas Points to Code and a Span</h2>
<ol class="areas col">
<li><b>Planning</b><p>Claude turns the docs page into a runbook and copies each command exactly.</p><span class="pf"><a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/planner.py#L319">planner.py</a><span><code>planner</code> AGENT span</span></span></li>
<li><b>Tool use</b><p>Firecrawl reads the page, Docker runs each step, and Jev classifies a failure.</p><span class="pf"><a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/classify.py#L128">classify.py</a><span>one TOOL span per call</span></span></li>
<li><b>State</b><p><code>state.json</code> is written after every step, so <code>firstrun run --resume RUN_ID</code> picks up a stopped run.</p><span class="pf"><a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/state.py#L52">state.py</a></span></li>
<li><b>Context</b><p>The planner reads only the quickstart page.</p><span class="pf"><a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/planner.py#L140">planner.py</a><span><code>read_docs</code> TOOL span</span></span></li>
<li><b>Execution</b><p>One fresh container per run, with the exit code on every step.</p><span class="pf"><a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/executor.py#L87">executor.py</a><span><code>step.N</code> TOOL span</span></span></li>
<li><b>Recovery</b><p>Classify, search, patch and retry, at most 3 times per step.</p><span class="pf"><a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/recovery.py#L300">recovery.py</a><span><code>recover.N</code> AGENT span</span></span></li>
<li><b>Verification</b><p>A second clean container reruns the patched steps with model calls blocked.</p><span class="pf"><a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/verify.py#L57">verify.py</a><span><code>verify</code> GUARDRAIL span</span></span></li>
<li><b>Iteration</b><p>v1 traces, 2 neatlogs detections, a planner fix, then v2 traces on the same targets.</p><span class="pf"><a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/commit/3ca6f118ecb0a8915315eea27b5588dd8a7c6299">commit 3ca6f11</a><a href="#before-after">the table below</a></span></li>
</ol>
<p class="ask">The agent asks a human once, only when Jev's top failure class is below 0.7 confidence. The answer is stored in <code>precedents.json</code>, so the same question never comes back. <a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/recovery.py#L29">The 0.7 threshold</a> <a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/src/firstrun/precedents.py">The ask-once store</a></p>

<div class="sub" id="recovery">
<h3>Trace 5520c5cf Failed Twice, Recovered and Passed 4 of 4 in a Fresh Container</h3>
<ol class="rec">
<li><span class="sp er"><em>ERROR</em>step.1</span><p>The Entire install step failed with <code>curl: command not found</code> in the <code>python:3.11-slim</code> container.</p></li>
<li><span class="sp okk"><em>RECOVERED</em>recover.1</span><p>Recovery reused a stored precedent and installed curl. <code>step.1</code> then passed in 110 s.</p></li>
<li><span class="sp er"><em>ERROR</em>step.2</span><p>The next step failed, because <code>~/.local/bin</code> was not on <code>PATH</code>.</p></li>
<li><span class="sp okk"><em>RECOVERED</em>recover.2</span><p>Recovery ran <code>classify_failure</code> and one Claude call ($0.0080), then put <code>~/.local/bin</code> on <code>PATH</code>. Steps 2, 3 and 4 passed.</p></li>
<li><span class="sp okk"><em>VERIFIED</em>verify</span><p>A fresh container ran steps 1 to 4 with no model call. All 4 passed in 264 s.</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="src col">30 spans, 417 s and $0.0095 at list price, from <a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/evidence/trace-recovered-entire-v2.md">trace-recovered-entire-v2.md</a>. <h2 id="broke-h">Five Things Broke While Building, and Each One Has a Number</h2>
<ol class="broke col">
<li><span class="num">206 s</span><p>Git 2.33 hung the Entire post-commit hook, and one checkpoint was lost. Git 2.55.0 fixed it, and the next hook took 3 s.</p></li>
<li><span class="num">3</span><p>The first live run split into 3 neatlogs traces. The CLI now opens one <code>firstrun.run</code> trace around the whole run.</p></li>
<li><span class="num">50</span><p>Each <code>pytest</code> run exported about 50 empty traces. The test fixture now sets an empty key, and the next run exported 0.</p></li>
<li><span class="num">39%</span><p>FirstRun counts cost 39% above neatlogs: $1.5253 against $1.0989 on 43 runs. The cap uses the higher count, so it stops a run early, never late.</p></li>
<li><span class="num">2</span><p>On Dagster, FirstRun called 2 gaps docs bugs, but the page already covered both. No PR went out, and every PR draft now gets a source check.</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="src col">The README lists every break in <a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun#what-broke-while-building">What Broke While Building</a>. The open gaps are in <a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/blob/main/docs/known-limits.md">known-limits.md</a>.</p>

<h2 id="repro-h">Four Commands Let You Check the Repo Yourself</h2>
<div class="code">
<div class="code-h"><span>Install and run</span><button type="button" class="cp" data-copy="run" aria-describedby="cp-status">Copy</button></div>
<pre id="run"><span class="p">$ </span>pip install git+https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun
<span class="p">$ </span>firstrun https://docs.example.com/quickstart</pre>
<p class="note">A run needs Python 3.11 or newer, Git, Docker and a Claude token in <code>CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN</code>. <a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun#run-your-first-check-in-5-minutes">README quickstart</a></p>
</div>
<div class="code">
<div class="code-h"><span>Run the offline tests, no network, Docker or keys</span><button type="button" class="cp" data-copy="test" aria-describedby="cp-status">Copy</button></div>
<pre id="test"><span class="p">$ </span>git clone https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun
<span class="p">$ </span>cd firstrun && pip install -e ".[dev]" && pytest -q</pre>
<p class="note">The README badge records 360 offline tests. A run on the launch branch on 2026-10-11 passed 360, skipped 65 that need <code>FIRSTRUN_LIVE=1</code> or a human check, and had 1 expected failure. <a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/actions">GitHub Actions</a></p>
</div>
<div class="code" id="dated">
<div class="code-h"><span>List the first commits with their dates, inside the clone</span><button type="button" class="cp" data-copy="dates" aria-describedby="cp-status">Copy</button></div>
<pre id="dates"><span class="p">$ </span>git log --reverse --date=iso --format="%h %ad %s" | head -3</pre>
<p class="note">The first line reads <code>96541a8 2026-10-10 12:34:51 +0530</code>. The kickoff was 12:30 IST. <a href="https://github.com/HighnessAtharva/firstrun/commits/main">All commits on GitHub</a></p>
</div>
<div class="code">
<div class="code-h"><span>Count the commits that carry an Entire checkpoint</span><button type="button" class="cp" data-copy="trail" aria-describedby="cp-status">Copy</button></div>
<pre id="trail"><span class="p">$ </span>git log --no-merges --format="%(trailers:key=Entire-Checkpoint,valueonly)" | grep -c .
<span class="p">$ </span>git rev-list --no-merges --count HEAD</pre>
<p class="note">entire.md counted 75 and 113 on 2026-10-11. Both numbers grow as new commits land on main.</p>
</div>
